'''Masataka Azuma''' (Japanese: '''我妻正崇''' ''Azuma Masataka'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Azuma was born sometime on January 25, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He became a voice actor as an adult and mostly got minor roles. He voiced one of his best-known roles as [[Oreburgh City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Roark]], during {{aniseries|DP}}. Azuma is currently affiliated with Max Mix, but apparently hasn't had any roles since 2009.
